description: Paid per call via x402: 0.01 RLUSD on XRPL or 0.01 USDC on Base. Returns a risk verdict (none, low, high, critical) with reasons and evidence; findings separates on-chain facts with transactions from heuristic signals. Critical requires on-chain proof. 'none' means no record, not that an address is safe. Call without payment to get the payment terms, then repeat with _meta["x402/payment"].

address.description: EVM address: token, deployer, wallet or contract.

chain.description: Optional chain name or id, for example base.

name: check_address
title: Check an EVM address for rug-pull risk
